metadata.description: Curated collection of production-ready Claude Code skills

plugins.name: better-stimulus
plugins.description: Apply Better Stimulus best practices for writing maintainable, reusable StimulusJS controllers following SOLID principles

plugins.name: rails-activity-timeline
plugins.description: Add polymorphic activity timelines with live Turbo Stream updates to any Rails model

plugins.name: rails-tiptap-autosave
plugins.description: Add Tiptap rich text editing with debounced autosave to Rails models using Stimulus

plugins.name: deletion-test
plugins.description: Run the regenerative-software deletion test on a component: extract intent and decision records, write a durable contract spec, mutation-test both oracles, regenerate the implementation in isolated arms, score by behavioral diff, and report evaluation gaps

plugins.name: graphs-and-shit
plugins.description: Pull the latest data from a survey, sheet, API, database or file and turn it into a shareable, editable Claude Doc with hand-drawn charts, each one screenshot-checked; refreshes the doc when the data changes

plugins.name: beat-the-benchmark-website
plugins.description: Build a website that measurably beats a named benchmark site: audit the benchmark, owner voting galleries, a parallel agent build with one integrator, QC and Codex review of an immutable preview, then a scope freeze and byte-parity production ship

plugins.name: ai-character-imaging
plugins.description: Keep one AI character or persona consistent across stills and motion loops: canon identity pack, prompt slots, owner review rounds, filter workarounds, waxy-free upscaling, feathered patch merges and seamless Kling loops
